title: Thoughts on Kimi K3?
author: Prophysaon_Coeruleum
selftext:
Twitter is going crazy over it - claims it can one-shot games like this - 

[https://x.com/intheworldofai/status/2077843115759501765](https://x.com/intheworldofai/status/2077843115759501765)  
  
Super impressive for a one-shot, but I'm not sure if it's real.    
  
Anyone tried it?

comments.author: Microtom_
comments.body:
I asked it to make me an idle fishing game. It spent over 20 minutes on it and was testing it itself. The prompt was just a small sentence.

The game was okay but you could spend money to increase the speed of the automated fishing and everything was becoming to fast to make sense.

comments.author: TypicalPay1655
comments.body:
I honestly hate those twitter product shills.

This is nowhere near "Red Dead Redemption 2 - like" game - it's literally just bunch of 3d assets slapped together without any optimization or gameplay mechanics. You can do most likely do it in Claude with free assets found on the internet.

replies.author: Prophysaon_Coeruleum
replies.body: Well, of course it's nowhere near RDR2, but still impressive for a one-shot IMO. Asked fable to one-shot a quake-like FPS and the assets it generated are composed of simple blocks.

replies.author: TypicalPay1655
replies.body:
I honestly find it hard to be impressed by this, because you will never be able to one-prompt a good gaming experience.

i love using AI, I am making a game using AI myself - but AI is a tool for creative souls to break boundaries that would normally take us years to break.

I can take my experience, my skills, my ideas, and get help from Claude to make them real without knowing how to program; these one-prompt shills are creating a husk without any real value and will because of them the wide perception of AI Gamedev only worsens. Regular people will not play this, would never buy this, they will not care about it being single-prompt, they will see "AI generated" will look at this 15fps choppy mess and laugh about it.

replies.author: elusivejoo
replies.body: but why do you care? im not trying to be a dick or anything and really want to know. I use AI just like you, i have lots of fleshed out ideas but dont know how to program and spend hours going back and fourth with codex and fable to get want i want. But i dont give 2 shits about what other people are doing with unless it helps my understanding, whether thats making one shot prompt games or gooning material. Ive just been trying to figure out why some people care so much what someone else is doing with AI if its not doing some type of harm.

replies.author: Shot_Crow_9833
replies.body: Don't bother , guys are dicks in here

replies.author: elusivejoo
replies.body: when i ask a real question and just get downvotes i know they have no actual response.... just vibes

replies.author: Prophysaon_Coeruleum
replies.body: yeah idk, they downvoted me too. Just trying to have a discussion, but seems like nobody's used it yet here

replies.author: TypicalPay1655
replies.body:
Wasn’t the one who downvoted you.  
I care about false advertising and the perception of AI by non AI folk, because truth is the AI bubble will praise you but won’t buy your game, and as long as the AI slop is being poured over everyone’s heads in tons the perception won’t change, so I simply care because I believe in AI as a creativity supporting tool

replies.author: elusivejoo
replies.body: ok, i can agree with that.

replies.author: Lily3704
replies.body: I don't have X so I can't see the thread - What did they say about this being a oneshot?

replies.author: Prophysaon_Coeruleum
replies.body: They said implied it came from a single prompt in the tweet

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
The problem is my guess is this is not "1 shot and the AI did it". The human almost certainly provided the AI with multiple assets.

1 shot games usually come with a more "low poly" type of graphics.

replies.author: Prior-Meeting1645
replies.body:
Dude thank you. When i first got into vibecoding I was losing my shit looking at their tweets going HOW.  
Its all bullshit and some have already said they’re paid which means its actually a thing and so I 100% believe they’re all paid or just fishing for views

comments.author: YKLKTMA
comments.body: One-time slop is only possible with this approach
